name: satc
description: The practice brain. Install canon into any repository and Count Bassy challenges from the firm's own record, never from its own opinion.

plugins.name: canon
plugins.description: Tenets — how to build, each carrying the incidents that proved it, ratified by the firm — convictions in the firm's own words, and eighteen standing behaviours. Bassy challenges from that record and never from an opinion, the docket hands back open decisions as a form, and an adversarial pass hands the code to another model to break and takes back only its tests. Holds no client data.

plugins.name: desk
plugins.description: Expert desks. A desk is an expert an agent consults so a question does not reach the firm: it answers only from cited authority, says how binding that authority is, and escalates rather than guesses. The engine verifies every citation before an answer is allowed out, and reports four outcomes with the costly one first. Depends on canon. Holds no client data.
plugins.displayName: desk — experts an agent can ask
